traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements from docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md are implemented and verified by tests.
• Core @supports functionality and format validation (REQ-SUPPORTS-PARSE, REQ-FORMAT-VALIDATION, REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT) are implemented in valid-annotation-format via the valid-implements-utils helpers and thoroughly tested in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts, including valid, missing, and malformed cases.
• Deep requirement validation for @supports (REQ-SUPPORTS-VALIDATE, REQ-SCOPED-IDS, REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT) is implemented in valid-req-reference-helpers.ts and exposed by the valid-req-reference rule. Tests in tests/rules/valid-req-reference.test.ts cover multi-story supports with shared IDs, missing requirements, and invalid paths, and confirm error messages include both reqId and storyPath.
• Presence rules require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation have been extended so that a function annotated only with @supports is accepted as satisfying both story and requirement presence (REQ-REQUIRE-ACCEPTS-SUPPORTS), while unannotated and legacy-only cases still behave as before (REQ-BACKWARD-COMPAT). This is covered by the dedicated tests in tests/rules/require-story-annotation.test.ts and tests/rules/require-req-annotation.test.ts, plus the shared reqAnnotationDetection helper tests.
• Mixed usage of @story/@req/@supports in the same comment and across files is explicitly supported and tested, and requirement IDs are scoped per story file (REQ-MIXED-SUPPORT, REQ-SCOPED-IDS).
• Error messages for missing requirements clearly indicate which story was checked via the reqMissing message template and associated tests (REQ-ERROR-CONTEXT).
• User-facing documentation (api-reference.md, migration-guide.md, README.md) explains @supports semantics, mixed usage with existing annotations, and the migration path from legacy annotations, satisfying the documentation acceptance criterion.
All relevant tests pass under npm test -- --verbose, so the implementation for this story remains correct and complete.
